d: Jordan conducts airstrikes on Syria in retaliation for the attack on St. George's Greek Orthodox Church on Friday. Amman says that it has eliminated over 20 fighters linked to the Islamic State terror group (ISIS). Syria has condemned the strikes, and says it was not informed about the operation in advance. Firstpost looks at the Jordanian operation and its aftermath. Hem Kaur Saroya also explains the reasons behind Jordan's attack. HKS gets the latest updates from the ground, including the reactions from both Amman and Damascus.
